input.quote: f) IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL; provided, however, that the foregoing will not restrict or prevent IBM from a) employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto
input.rationale: Section 9.0(f) is the only non-solicitation provision in the Agreement and it binds IBM alone. It fails the fallback on three material terms: it is one-sided rather than mutual; it covers every Transferred Employee regardless of involvement in performing this Agreement; and it runs for "[*] years" from the Effective Date rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement. It prohibits solicitation only and expressly permits hiring, so there is no no-hire. Operation 1 makes the restriction mutual, limits it to the other party's personnel directly involved in performing this Agreement and caps it at 12 months after that involvement ends; operation 2 conforms the retained carve-outs so they excuse either party, states the general solicitation/employment advertising exclusion expressly, and replaces the now-dangling "such Transferred Employees" with "such personnel". Note for the client: the involvement-based scope re-cuts rather than uniformly narrows the covered population.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
